task: Sync the updated codemie-html-report skill and the new humanizer skill from codemie-public-skills into the CodeMie Claude plugin, bump the plugin version, and validate the result.

key_reasoning.reason: Several design decisions are still open. (1) Keep the source <skill-dir> and bare references/ paths, or rewrite them to the repo's ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/skills/<name>/ convention? sync-plugin.ts copies only SKILL.md, so the bare paths break there. (2) Remove the stale bundle.css or keep it. (3) Update the codemie-analytics SKILL.md consumer, which still documents the old /*__CSS__*/ flow with no build.js. (4) Decide what to do with the EPAM 'All rights reserved' LICENSE and headers in an Apache-2.0 repo. (5) Decide whether evals/ and vendor-assets.mjs ship. (6) 'Fully validate' has no defined harness or acceptance criteria.

About 14 files are modified: 12 changed html-report files, plugin.json, and likely codemie-analytics SKILL.md and CHANGELOG. About 39 are new: 23 html-report files and 16 humanizer files. The new-file count alone reaches the XXL threshold (6+ new). I scored XL because nearly all new files are verbatim asset copies inside two skill directories under one plugin tree, with no effect on project structure or shared foundations. The project L example (profile-provider-decoupling) applied file counts literally, so a calibrator could argue for XXL here. That would make the total 21 (L), and the routing would still be brainstorming.

2-3 components in the Claude plugin asset tree: the codemie-html-report skill (replaced and extended), the new humanizer skill, and the plugin manifest version. The codemie-analytics SKILL.md is a likely consumer to update. No TypeScript source has to change: copy-plugins.js, sync-plugin.ts and BaseExtensionInstaller pick up the change automatically.
